home.aboutText: I'm Albert Grabar, a full-stack developer in Paris (PHP/Symfony, React). Before code, the French Foreign Legion, from 2016 to 2024: I deliver what I promise, when I promise it.

faq.q: Do you work with private individuals?
faq.a: Yes: personal websites, portfolios, WordPress blogs, AI-built apps for personal projects. You get a written quote and keep your consumer rights: a 14-day withdrawal period and free mediation if there is a dispute.

faq.q: I'm not a developer — is that a problem?
faq.a: No: the report is written in plain language, with risks and priorities.

faq.q: Do I own the code?
faq.a: Yes: once paid in full, the code and all access are yours.

faq.q: Do you use AI?
faq.a: Yes, as a tool and under my control: every change is reviewed and tested before delivery.

faq.q: Why only in writing?
faq.a: Everything stays traceable: what was asked, what's done, what's left. Write any time; I reply within 24 hours.

detail.h1: An audit of your AI-built app
detail.lead: You built an app with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, v0 or Replit. Before you show it to customers or take payments, I check what could break or leak, and tell you what to fix, in what order and for what price.

sections.title: Who it's for
items: Individuals: you built an app for a personal project or a future business and want to know if it's safe.
Founders and small businesses: you're about to open the app to real customers, take payments or collect personal data.
Non-technical agencies and freelancers: you want a second opinion before delivering to your client.

items.d: No API key or password should be visible in the code sent to the browser or in the Git repository.
Access rules (for example Row Level Security on Supabase): each user reads and changes only their own data.
Sign-up, password reset, sessions, private pages and admin roles.
Stripe in live mode: amounts checked on the server, webhooks, receipts, failed payments and refunds.

Loading time, mobile version, page titles and descriptions.

Read access to the code (GitHub) and a test account. I never need your personal passwords.

items.t: I review it for 2 working days
items.d: Reading the code, testing in the browser, checking the database and payments in test mode.
Issues ranked by severity (critical, important, minor), explained in plain language, with a fix plan and a fixed price.

sections.title: What you get
items: A written report (PDF) in English or French.
For each issue: where it is, the concrete risk and how to fix it.

sections.title: What's not included
items: The fixes themselves: they're part of Launch or a separate quote.

sections.title: Price and payment
items: €150 up to 10 screens, €250 above. Fixed price, confirmed in writing before I start.

faq.q: My app was made with a no-code tool. Can you audit it?
faq.a: Yes, if I can access the code or its export: Lovable, Bolt and v0 can push it to GitHub. For a tool without export, I first tell you in writing what I can check.

faq.q: Will you change my app?
faq.a: No. The audit is read-only: I change nothing without your written agreement.

faq.q: What if the audit finds nothing serious?
faq.a: Good news: the report says so clearly, with possible improvements. The price stays the same, because the checking work is the same.

faq.q: What do you do with my code and data?
faq.a: I use them only for the audit and delete my copies at the end of the job. I can sign a non-disclosure agreement.

faq.q: My app is on Lovable or Bolt. Do I have to leave it?
faq.a: Not necessarily. I recommend the simplest option: stay on the tool if it's safe, or export the code to hosting in your name if needed. The choice is written in the quote.

faq.q: Will the accounts (hosting, Stripe) be in my name?
faq.a: Yes, always. I work with access you give me and can remove at any time.

faq.q: What if the deadline is missed?
faq.a: The deadline starts with the deposit and access. If I'm late through my own fault, I tell you in writing with a new date; you can then cancel the part not yet done.

faq.q: Can you add a feature?
faq.a: Yes, on a separate quote. That way the Launch price stays as announced.

about.title: About — Albert Grabar, full-stack web developer in Paris
about.description: From the French Foreign Legion (2016–2024) to a professional diploma in web and mobile development. I help individuals and businesses launch AI-built apps and websites that work.
about.h1: Albert Grabar, full-stack web developer in Paris
paragraphs: From 2016 to 2024 I served in the French Foreign Legion, as a corporal in the 2nd Foreign Engineer Regiment. I was in charge of my company's armoury: equipment maintenance, inventories, strict safety procedures. It taught me to prepare a mission, deliver it on time and report in writing.

In July 2025 I earned the French professional diploma in web and mobile development (EQF level 5) at AFPA Chartres. My personal project, TECH NOIR, is an online store built with Symfony and React. Before the Legion I studied law, which helps when an app has to comply with GDPR.

Today I help founders of AI-built apps go from prototype to real product, and small businesses as well as private individuals get a website that works. I work solo as a registered French micro-business, using AI tools under my control.
